# Toolify PDF

> Toolify PDF is a free, browser-based suite of PDF and image processing tools. All processing happens securely in your browser — no files are uploaded to any server.

## Tools

- [PDF to Word](https://toolifypdf.online/pdf-to-word): Convert PDF files to editable Word documents (.docx).
- [PDF to Excel](https://toolifypdf.online/pdf-to-excel): Extract tables from PDFs into Excel spreadsheets (.xlsx).
- [PDF to PowerPoint](https://toolifypdf.online/pdf-to-ppt): Convert PDF slides to editable PowerPoint (.pptx).
- [PDF to JPG](https://toolifypdf.online/pdf-to-jpg): Export every PDF page as a high-quality JPG image.
- [Merge PDF](https://toolifypdf.online/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF files into one document.
- [Split PDF](https://toolifypdf.online/split-pdf): Separate a PDF into individual pages or custom ranges.
- [Compress PDF](https://toolifypdf.online/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file size while preserving quality.
- [Rotate PDF](https://toolifypdf.online/rotate-pdf): Rotate pages in a PDF document.
- [Organize PDF](https://toolifypdf.online/organize-pdf): Reorder, rotate, or delete pages in a PDF.
- [Repair PDF](https://toolifypdf.online/repair-pdf): Attempt to recover damaged or unreadable PDF files.
- [Page Numbers](https://toolifypdf.online/page-numbers): Add page numbers to a PDF document.
- [Watermark PDF](https://toolifypdf.online/watermark-pdf): Add a text or image watermark to every page of a PDF.
- [Protect PDF](https://toolifypdf.online/protect-pdf): Add a password to a PDF document.
- [Unlock PDF](https://toolifypdf.online/unlock-pdf): Remove a known password from a PDF document.
- [PDF Editor](https://toolifypdf.online/pdf-editor): Add text, shapes, and signatures to a PDF.
- [Word to PDF](https://toolifypdf.online/word-to-pdf): Convert Word documents (.docx) to PDF format.
- [Excel to PDF](https://toolifypdf.online/excel-to-pdf): Convert Excel spreadsheets (.xlsx) to PDF format.
- [PowerPoint to PDF](https://toolifypdf.online/ppt-to-pdf): Convert PowerPoint presentations (.pptx) to PDF format.
- [HTML to PDF](https://toolifypdf.online/html-to-pdf): Convert a web page or HTML file to PDF.
- [Image to PDF](https://toolifypdf.online/image-to-pdf): Convert JPG, PNG, and other image formats to PDF.
- [Crop Image](https://toolifypdf.online/crop-image): Crop images online.
- [Resize Image](https://toolifypdf.online/resize-image): Change image dimensions online.
- [Convert Image](https://toolifypdf.online/convert-image): Convert images between formats such as JPG, PNG, and WebP.
- [Compress Image](https://toolifypdf.online/compress-image): Reduce image file size without visible quality loss.

## About

- All tools run entirely in the browser using WebAssembly — your files never leave your device.
- No account or login required.
- Free to use with no file size restrictions for most tools.
- Available in multiple languages.
